narration: Your false bell turns both masks toward the far roof. The cut rope snaps, but the loaded sled hesitates on one warped runner; gravity needs a precise kick before the guards look back. Time it well and the crates will divide them at the sinkhole. Miss, and the sled will clang broadside while both still share a clear route to you. Make a Dexterity (Sleight of Hand) check, DC 12.

ruling.understoodAction: Use Minor Illusion as a diversion, release the loaded mud-sled, and split the guards with the sinkhole.
ruling.ruling: The illusion works; placing the unstable sled requires precise timing.
ruling.stakes: Success separates the guards before combat; failure alerts both with an open route to Mira.
